description: Searches Google Patents by keywords, with optional inventor, assignee, country, status and date filters, and returns the source JSON (organic_results with title, patent_id, link and other fields). Use it for inventions and patent publications. It does not return full patent texts or claims, and is not for research papers (use search_scholar). Required: query.

after.description: Earliest publication date included, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2020-01-01"; omitted means no cutoff. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

assignee.description: Assignee (owner) name filter, e.g. "Toyota"; omitted means any assignee. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

before.description: Latest publication date included, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2025-12-31"; must not precede after; omitted means no cutoff. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

country.description: Patent office country code, e.g. "US", "EP" or "JP"; omitted means any country. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

inventor.description: Inventor name filter, e.g. "Jane Smith"; omitted means any inventor. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

language.description: Patent language filter as used in Google Patents search URLs, e.g. "ENGLISH"; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

num.description: Results per page, integer 1-100, e.g. 20; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

page.description: One-based result page, integer at least 1, e.g. 2; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

query.description: Required patent search keywords, e.g. "solar cell"; no default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

sort.description: Sort order: new (newest first) or old (oldest first), e.g. "new"; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

status.description: Patent status filter as used in Google Patents search URLs, e.g. "GRANT" or "APPLICATION"; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

name: search_patents
title: Search Google Patents
